title: SecurityCouncilAnalysisDocument
description: Portable structured-output envelope for the house ANALYSIS prompts (threat model, attack path, hardening, policy, write-up) driven through claude --json-schema / codex --output-schema / agy --json-schema. A document, never a finding. Same portability rules as the finding envelope: no $schema, pattern, or length/range/count keywords (strict structured-output modes reject them); bounds and path rules are enforced post-generation by artifacts.validate_document.
